about: MCP servers in the same estate that an agent can use alongside this one. Each entry records where its manifest came from and when. This server does not call them; it tells an agent they exist and what they are for, so the estate is one set of domains rather than unconnected servers.

domains.title: NDL PubSec MCP
domains.description: Find UK public sector data, check metadata against xGov MEM, explain open standards and look up business terms with their certification state.

domains.title: Public Sector Data Quality Commons
domains.description: Check data against quality rules, draft rules, assess against framework packs, translate results between frameworks and score issues with the UK government issues framework.

safety.personal_data: results contain examples of failing rows; keep the root folder free of data the agent should not see
safety.human_in_loop: rules drafted by an agent must be reviewed before use

domains.note: The dq-commons manifest lists 12 tools; its server registers 15. Not in the manifest as of 2252179: estimate_effort, playbook, weave_rules. Raised with dq-commons.
